verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own docs describe a Session Replay feature for watching user sessions, with sampling managed from the UI and saved playlists of replays, so the core of watching real user sessions is covered. Nothing in the evidence documents masking of sensitive input, by default or otherwise, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: documented default masking of sensitive inputs, any privacy controls specific to replay, and independent or hands-on corroboration of replay.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default

citations.quote: Now, with Mixpanel Session Replay, you can quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off.
teams can manage Session Replay sampling directly from the Mixpanel UI — no code changes or redeployment required.
